description: Issue #13 task 4: add a data-integrity CHECK that detects FINISHED games/series that still reference an undetermined / TBD / placeholder team, and surface them as non-blocking data-integrity warnings on the bracket response. A placeholder team is one whose id is not present in @mlb/shared TEAMS (the live 2026 feed carries ids with names like 'AL Higher Seed' / 'Higher Seed League Champion' that are not real teams). Depends on FEAT-002 only for build ordering; logically independent.
steps: Add a pure helper in @mlb/shared (new module shared/src/integrity.ts, re-exported from index.ts) because it operates on the shared Bracket type and must be testable without AWS. Define an IntegrityWarning type, e.g. { code: 'finished_game_tbd_team'; seriesId: string; round: RoundName; league: SeriesLeague; teamId: number; scope: 'series' | 'game'; gamePk?: number } and a function `findIntegrityWarnings(bracket: Bracket): IntegrityWarning[]`.

Implement the check: iterate bracket.series. A team id is a placeholder when `!(teamId in TEAMS)` (TEAMS is the shared real-team map). Flag a series-level warning when series.status === 'final' and either series.high.teamId or series.low.teamId is a placeholder. Flag a game-level warning when a game is finished (it has a decided winner: away.isWinner === true || home.isWinner === true) but a participating team id (away.teamId or home.teamId) is a placeholder. Return a deterministic, de-duplicated, stably-ordered list (e.g. ordered by round progression then seriesId then teamId). An empty bracket or a bracket with only real teams yields an empty array.

Surface the warnings on the bracket API. Extend the Bracket contract OR the bracket handler response with an optional `integrityWarnings?: IntegrityWarning[]`. Prefer attaching it in backend/src/handlers/getBracket.ts (compute via findIntegrityWarnings over the resolved bracket and include it in the JSON body) and ALSO log a concise server-side warning (console.warn with count + series ids) so it is observable in Lambda logs. Keep the field optional so existing consumers/tests that ignore it are unaffected, and keep the response HTTP 200.

If you add the field to the Bracket type in shared/src/types.ts, make it optional so the aggregator and seed data need not populate it; the handler fills it. Choose ONE place to attach it (handler response is simplest and keeps aggregateBracket pure) and document the choice in a code comment.

Tests: add shared/src/integrity.test.ts (unit) covering: a final series with a placeholder team is flagged; a finished game with a placeholder team is flagged; a scheduled/upcoming series with placeholder teams (normal for a not-yet-determined bracket) is NOT flagged; an all-real-teams final bracket yields []; empty bracket yields []. Add a property-based test shared/src/integrity.property.test.ts (fast-check) asserting an invariant such as: every returned warning references a teamId that is NOT in TEAMS and a series whose status is 'final' (for series-scope) or a game with a decided winner (for game-scope); and findIntegrityWarnings never throws on arbitrary valid Bracket inputs. Add a backend handler test (getBracket) asserting the response includes integrityWarnings when the bracket contains a finished placeholder matchup.
acceptance_criteria: findIntegrityWarnings flags finished (final-series or decided-game) matchups that reference a team id absent from TEAMS, and does NOT flag not-yet-started/scheduled placeholder matchups.
The GET /bracket response carries an optional integrityWarnings array (empty when clean) and the server logs a concise warning when non-empty, all at HTTP 200.
A fast-check property test asserts warnings only ever reference placeholder team ids in finished contexts and the function never throws.
`npm run build` and `npm test` pass for @mlb/shared and @mlb/backend.
verification: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build -w @mlb/shared && PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build -w @mlb/backend
findings: Implemented a pure, dependency-free data-integrity check in @mlb/shared and surfaced it on the bracket API. Files changed: shared/src/integrity.ts (NEW: IntegrityWarning type + findIntegrityWarnings(bracket) -> deterministic, de-duped, round/seriesId/scope/teamId/gamePk-ordered list; placeholder = !(teamId in TEAMS); flags final-series seeds and decided-game participants only); shared/src/index.ts (re-export ./integrity.js); shared/src/types.ts (added optional Bracket.integrityWarnings?, populated by handler not the pure aggregator/seed); backend/src/handlers/getBracket.ts (compute via findIntegrityWarnings over resolved bracket, spread onto 200 JSON body, console.warn concise count+seriesIds when non-empty; aggregateBracket stays pure - choice documented in a code comment). Tests added (all colocated in @mlb/shared where vitest already runs *.test.ts): shared/src/integrity.test.ts (6 unit: final-series placeholder flagged, decided-game placeholder flagged, scheduled placeholder NOT flagged, all-real final -> [], empty -> [], dedupe+ordering), shared/src/integrity.property.test.ts (2 fast-check properties: every warning references a non-TEAMS id in a finished context + series/game scope invariants, never throws, output de-duplicated), backend/src/handlers/getBracket.test.ts (1: vi.mock of mlb/client to aggregate a final placeholder matchup; asserts 200 + non-empty integrityWarnings + console.warn fired). Verification (Node v22.23.3): npm run build -w @mlb/shared && -w @mlb/backend PASS; npm test -w @mlb/shared PASS (22 tests, 8 new); npm test -w @mlb/backend PASS (78 tests, 1 new). Frontend build also verified green (additive shared export, no regression); dist/ is gitignored so no build artifacts committed. No deviations from the plan. Commit: see commit_hash below.
